subject: Pilot runbook & weekly keep-alive for Zephyr AI evaluation
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@zephyr.ai>, Priya Bhat <priya.b@zephyr.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + proposed success criteria for Zephyr pilot

Thanks for taking the call earlier — quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock the pilot scope.

Key outcomes from today:
- Goal: validate Zephyr’s intent routing on customer support transcripts and measure production economics on our infra.
- Proposed pilot length: 2 weeks (production-ish workload) with a single model variant.

Suggested success criteria (please confirm):
1) Latency: 95th percentile inference latency < 200ms for 512-token requests under steady load.
2) Relevance: Top-1 intent accuracy >= 85% on your annotated validation set.
3) Stability: No more than one degraded run (error spike) requiring manual intervention across the pilot window.
4) Cost envelope: Token cost/unit prediction within 20% of our estimate (we’ll share baseline).

Proposed next steps and owners:
- Redwood provides: Pilot runbook + onboarding checklist (I’ll attach a first draft) — owner: me (Olga).
- Zephyr provides: 1) validation dataset (sample of 2k transcripts), 2) access credentials for a read-only S3 bucket — owner: Alex.
- Kickoff: propose Monday 2027-09-20, 10:00am PT — tentative until we hear from procurement.

Can you confirm the success criteria above and whether the 2-week window works? If procurement needs a different timeline, flag that now and we’ll accommodate.

Thanks — I’ll follow up later today with the runbook draft.

Best,
Olga
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: zephyr_pilot_runbook_v1.pdf]

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@zephyr.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Bhat <priya.b@zephyr.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed success criteria for Zephyr pilot

Thanks, Olga — great recap. Confirming a few items from our side:

- Stakeholders: Alex Chen (platform lead), Priya Bhat (procurement), and Samir Joshi (head of CS) will be engaged.
- Validation set: we can deliver the 2k-transcript sample by Wed 2027-09-15.
- Timeline: the team prefers a 3-week pilot if procurement needs more time to finalize contract terms. Operationally a 2-week run is fine, but give us a 1-week buffer to absorb contract sign-off.

Also a couple of constraints: we need the Redwood team to whitelist a small set of IPs (we’ll provide) and confirm that no customer PII is written to long-term logs during the trial.

I’ll route the PO conversation to procurement (cc’d Priya). Once procurement signals green, we’ll confirm kickoff date.

—Alex
Platform Lead, Zephyr AI

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot runbook (v1) + onboarding checklist — please review

Attached is the first draft of the pilot runbook and our onboarding checklist. High-level schedule in the doc:
- Week 0 (prep, access & dataset delivery) — owners: Alex + Aditya (Redwood infra setup)
- Week 1 (baseline runs, tuning, validation sampling) — owners: Redwood MLE + Zephyr ML lead
- Week 2 (stress runs, metrics collection, acceptance tests) — owners: joint ops
- Optional Week 3: buffer for procurement/contract delays and extra iterations.

Runbook highlights (callouts):
- Acceptance tests: we’ll run the annotated validation set and provide a regression report within 24h of test completion.
- Data handling: we will only cache ephemeral KV during inference; long-term logs are disabled by default for pilot accounts.
- Security: KMS-managed keys for ephemeral stores; audit logs available for the duration.

Please review the attached and confirm: 1) dataset delivery ETA (Alex), 2) IP whitelist (Alex), 3) procurement timeline (Priya).

Attachments:
- zephyr_pilot_runbook_v1.pdf (pilot schedule, acceptance tests, roles)
- redwood_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (access matrix, run commands, point-of-contact)

Related links:
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/ZPH-2027-09-001
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/zephyr-pilot

Thanks — keen to get this started.

—Olga
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: redwood_onboarding_checklist.xlsx]

Looping in a few operational notes from our CS/onboarding playbook: 

1) Data ingestion: please share a small S3 prefix (sample) + IAM read role. We’ll validate schema against the runbook.
2) Pairing session: propose a 90-min pairing with Zephyr ML engineer and one of our infra engineers to verify end-to-end requests (proposed: Thu 2027-09-16, 09:00am PT).
3) Monitoring: we will wire up a short dashboard that surfaces latency percentiles, error rate, and token spend. Monica will own the dashboard during the pilot.

Action items:
- Alex: S3 sample + IAM role by Wed 2027-09-15 (confirmed on call).
- Aditya (Redwood): prepare ephemeral cluster and provide IPs for whitelist by Fri 2027-09-17.
- Priya: procurement ETA (cc’d) — any updates are fine.

If everyone is comfortable with the pairing slot, Monica will send calendar invites and the dashboard link.

Thanks,
Monica
